name: Your own model
description: Any OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint: vLLM, llama.cpp, LM Studio, SGLang, TGI, or a model you're serving yourself. Point it at the URL and call it to see how it behaves under a real conversation.

base_url.title: Endpoint
base_url.description: Where your server listens, including the version path. From Docker, reach your machine as host.docker.internal.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model name your server expects.

api_key_env.title: API key variable
api_key_env.description: Name of an environment variable holding the key, if your server needs one. The key itself never goes in the config.

max_tokens.title: Max tokens
max_tokens.description: Upper bound on the length of each reply. Shorter replies reach the caller sooner.
